name: Cross Proactive Reactive Control

cross_template_interactions.description: SN switching signals environmental salience; triggers transition from proactive (sustained task goals) to reactive (immediate environmental response) control mode.
Trait conscientiousness favors proactive control (goal maintenance); neuroticism may bias toward reactive control (threat-responsiveness). Individual differences set control mode baseline preference.
Perceived control affects control mode sustainability: high control enables sustained proactive mode; low control forces reactive mode switching (loss of goal focus).
Cultural uncertainty avoidance affects control mode preference: high-UA cultures favor sustained proactive planning; low-UA cultures show flexible reactive mode adoption.

Proactive/reactive control operates at top of hierarchical control stack: chooses which hierarchy level is currently goal-relevant. Hierarchy determines goal content; proactive/reactive determines goal persistence.
Proactive control maintains goal representations in WM (beta maintenance); reactive control relies on transient WM encoding (gamma burst). Control mode choice determines WM dynamics.
